title: Parse a compact duration
prompt: Write a function parse_duration(text) that parses a compact duration such as '1h30m', '45s' or '30m1h' into a whole number of seconds. Units are h (hours), m (minutes) and s (seconds). The text is one or more groups of digits immediately followed by a unit, with no spaces. Each unit may appear at most once and groups may be in any order. Raise ValueError for an empty, malformed or repeated-unit input.
